original_target.title: Quadratic-scale bit complexity for well-conditioned sparse systems

scope_comparison: The deterministic bit algorithm has sparse input and Otilde(nm log(kappa/epsilon)) complexity for logarithmic-bit fixed/floating inputs. Rational inputs with O(c logn)-bit numerator/denominator admit O(c logn)-bit grid rounding preserving conditioning and inverse-polynomial tolerance. Choosing residual tolerance smaller by kappa, with rounding slack, gives the required relative solution error. Polynomial conditioning makes the extra logarithm polylogn. The deterministic guarantee implies success probability0.99.
